svg.text: 551 mm up; bore 62 mm across it, then a 28 mm hole down its middle.

svg.text: (26 mm hole), a 10 mm floor with a 28 mm hole 8 mm below the nut.

svg.text: The nut lifts the stem by the cap; the 8 mm gap is the float.

svg.text: mm head turned on, pull knob, 6 mm hole for the R-clip. Do not weld it.
